title: The Sims Legacy Collection
provenance: verified locally on Apple Silicon (M1 Pro), engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r2, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.9.3 mattpilott (highball-db#160, 2026-09-20): rated 4, playable with minor issues, Apple M4, macOS 27.0, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r5, Highball 0.9.32, DXVK, 54 minutes played through Highball with the recipe (MVK_SHADOW_IMPORT=1 in the environment); the minor issues were not described.
notes: Re-verified on engine r2 on 2026-09-10: launches from Steam and reaches the neighbourhood view at 99.3 fps, 1728x1117, 2.8 ms of GPU per frame, presenting directly rather than through the compositor. No MoltenVK device losses in the run, so the shadow-import fix is holding. EA's 2025 re-release draws with Vulkan rather than Direct3D, so the renderer setting has no effect on it; the bottle's renderer is irrelevant (dxvk here). It needs engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r1 or newer plus the Sims recipe, which sets MVK_SHADOW_IMPORT=1. On older engines the window opens black with the game running behind it: the game is 32-bit, Wine imports its own host memory into MoltenVK, and Metal loses the device on the first frame (kIOGPUCommandBufferCallbackErrorOutOfMemory, six times, then nothing). With the patched engine it plays: neighbourhood and lot load, Sims take orders, 65 fps at 1728x1117. Reported black-screen elsewhere on M4 and M5 machines (highball-db issue #7, KhronosGroup/MoltenVK#2766); the fix is not chip-specific.

verified.fps: 99.3 in the neighbourhood view at 1728x1117 on DXVK with 2.8 ms of GPU per frame (2026-09-10, engine r2)

knownIssues.symptom: Sims drawn as black silhouettes on the lot, and in the neighbourhood view the family portrait is coloured noise and the lot preview a black block (reported on an M4, macOS 27, engine r5, Highball 0.9.32, DXVK, 2880x1620)
knownIssues.cause: reported, not reproduced yet: on an M1 Pro with the same engine and Highball 0.9.34 the neighbourhood and an empty lot (walls, floors, objects, trees) drew correctly on 2026-09-21; an occupied lot and a family portrait were not reached in that session. The pattern (small textures arriving as uninitialised memory) points at the host-memory import path this 32-bit Vulkan game needs (MVK_SHADOW_IMPORT=1)
knownIssues.fix: None yet. The game plays through it; tracked from highball-db#160.
